page.overview:
Who is Gretz Droom?

Gretz Droom was a Jedi Master who sat on the Jedi High Council during the Republic Era. As an initiate, Droom was chosen from Heliost Clan to be the Padawan of Master Jor Aerith. They were later elevated to the rank of Jedi Knight, and eventually to Jedi Master, serving on the Jedi Council.

Born around 84 BBY, Gretz Droom was identified as Force-sensitive as a child, and brought to the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant to be trained as an initiate in the Jedi Order. They became a member of the Heliost Clan, alongside a number of other initiates, including Qui-Gon Jinn and Ky Narec.

During a Jedi mission to the planet Asusto the Padawan Dooku was given numerous visions of possible futures after being subjected to torture by the Presagers of Hakotei. In one vision, Droom, as a Jedi Master on the Jedi High Council, declared that the Galactic Senate had become corrupted and the Jedi needed to take control. Dooku saw Droom kill Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, announcing that the rule of the Jedi had begun. When the vision ceased, Jedi Master Lene Kostana assured Dooku that the visions he had seen were not certainties.

In 68 BBY, Droom, along with the rest of their clan, were selected to undergo their Initiate Trials. Droom spoke with Narec while they and Jinn watched fellow initiates Ima-Gun Di and Yeeda duel. Droom themself was later picked, chosen to duel Narec, who was dismayed upon hearing his opponent. Both Padawans hoped to be chosen as a Padawan by Dooku, now a Jedi Master, and Droom was confident they could succeed.
